# שָׁרְט

```
║    شَرْط ← → שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / incision              ║
║    stipulation / scratch             ║
║                                      ║
║    the cut that binds                ║
║    the wound that contracts          ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

    ש ═══ ش
    ר ═══ ر  
    ט ═══ ط

```
root: √š-r-ṭ

to cut lines into skin
to make conditions
to set terms

the same gesture:
    scoring flesh
    signing contracts

what you carve
    becomes
        what you owe
```
